title: 第3章 白光 土种契机
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

少女放下了自己手上的东西，对云澈说道：

“你的伤势还没有好，来这里做什么啊，这里有我。”

云澈在伤势没有好的情况下来这里会旧伤复发的。

云澈摇头道：“我没事，你离开吧，我和她单独说说。”

少女闻言，起初还是拒绝的，但她看到云澈的样子后，离开了房间。

千叶影儿恶变传来一道云澈的声音：

“她已经离开了，可以睁开眼睛。”

千叶影儿早就醒了，她就是在等着云澈的到来。

千叶影儿睁开自己的眼睛，与云澈双目对视，那目光之中渗透出了一丝丝喜悦：

“我们来到深渊了？”

她被空间风暴无情的击溃，在那时对是否来到深渊没有半点信心。

云澈坐在她身侧，手掌轻轻的触碰在千叶影儿伤势之上。

指尖出现黑暗玄力，黑暗玄力缓缓的进入千叶影儿体内，为千叶影儿治愈伤势。

千叶影儿伤势在黑暗玄力之下缓缓的恢复着，她意识到了一个问题：

“云澈，你我二人跳下无之深渊，外伤看似严重，但内伤根本就没有，这究竟是为什么呢？”

她意识到了这样的一个问题，外伤显得非常的严重。

但内伤他们二人都没有。

这种情况就表明了不简单。

“我也在思考这个问题。”

云澈眼神微微的凝住，说道：“在我昏迷之前，我看到了一道白光浮现在我视线之前。”

那道白光不是寻常的白光，而是极其耀眼的白光。

凡是看到了那道白光，任何人都不会忘记。

他对千叶影儿的问题自苏醒之后就思考了很久。

在如此思考之下，他将这一切都指向了那道白光。

千叶影儿黛眉微微蹙起，金眸之中闪过一道金芒：

“你是说，是那道白光治愈了我们内伤。”

空间风暴的撕扯太强大，在昏迷中她能够清晰的感知到自己所受的伤势是有着多么的严重。

那道白光究竟是谁，能够使他们内伤恢复的如此之快。

“先别想这个问题了。”

云澈将白光一事抛之于脑后，对千叶影儿说道：

“我们如今身处在白炎界中，这里临近于雾海。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

The girl put down what she was holding and said to Yun Che:

"Your injury hasn't healed yet. What are you doing here? I'm here."

If Yun Che comes here without recovering from his injuries, his old injuries will relapse.

Yun Che shook his head and said: "I'm fine. Please leave. I'll talk to her alone."

When the girl heard this, she refused at first, but after seeing Yun Che's appearance, she left the room.

Qianye Ying'er's evil transformation came from Yun Che's voice:

"She's gone and can open her eyes."

Qianye Ying'er had woken up a long time ago, and she was just waiting for Yun Che's arrival.

Qianye Ying'er opened her eyes and looked into Yun Che's eyes. There was a trace of joy in her eyes:

"Are we in the abyss?"

She was ruthlessly defeated by the space storm. At that time, she had no confidence in whether she would reach the abyss.

Yun Che sat beside her and gently touched Qianye Ying'er's injury with his palm.

Dark mysterious power appeared on the fingertips, and the dark mysterious power slowly entered Qianye Ying'er's body, healing Qianye Ying'er's injuries.

Qianye Ying'er's injuries slowly recovered under the dark mysterious power, and she realized a problem:

"Yun Che, you and I jumped into the Abyss of Nothingness. The external injuries seemed serious, but there were no internal injuries at all. Why is this?"

She realized such a problem, and the trauma seemed very serious.

But neither of them had any internal injuries.

This situation shows that it is not simple.

"I'm thinking about this too."

Yun Che's eyes froze slightly and he said, "Before I passed out, I saw a white light appearing in front of my sight."

That white light was not an ordinary white light, but an extremely dazzling white light.

Anyone who saw that white light will never forget it.

He had been thinking about Qianye Ying'er's question for a long time since he woke up.

After thinking like this, he pointed everything towards the white light.

Qianye Ying'er frowned slightly, and a golden light flashed in her golden eyes:

"You mean, it was the white light that healed our internal injuries."

The tearing force of the space storm was so powerful that in her coma, she could clearly feel how serious her injuries were.

Who is that white light that can make them recover from internal injuries so quickly?

"Don't think about this problem yet."

Yun Che put the white light incident behind him and said to Qianye Ying'er:

"We are now in the White Flame Realm, which is close to the Sea of Mist."
